totals.note: Each matched deal record counts once, regardless of how many articles report it. Counts are measured over the entire filtered window, independent of result limits. USD amounts use fixed conversion rates, not current or transaction-date exchange rates. Only usable amounts enter sums, medians and maxima: finite, positive, converted to USD and at most 25,000,000,000 USD. Larger or unconverted figures are counted in deals_amount_excluded. Sums and medians count one company and amount once, because the same round is often reported under several round labels. Missing, zero, negative and non-finite amounts count as unknown; amount statistics are null when no matched deal has a usable amount. Deal records include equity rounds, debt facilities, placements and announced commitments. Amounts are reported figures, not independently verified financial amounts.
